summary: Campus service lane between buildings; no stopping signs, no parked cars, nowhere to pull off.
reasons: Service lane hemmed in by university buildings
No parked cars or pull-off room

drivers.seclusion: Walled in by Building 33, Schonell Theatre and the UQ Centre; busy campus core with foot traffic.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow paved lane with building walls on both sides; no verge or bay, a bollard sits near the start.
drivers.traffic: Delivery and service traffic in the campus centre, plus pedestrians.
drivers.convention: No Stopping Mon-Fri 7am-6pm and No Stopping Any Time signs; no cars parked along it.

sun_shade: Shaded by buildings on both sides for much of the day.
